run_doctest_extending: run the doctest suite for the Boost.Python extending example module
test_hello_greet: test the hello class greet method returns a greeting string for a given place
test_invite_function: test the invite function returns an invitation message for a hello instance
test_wordy_subclass: test subclassing hello to override greet with additional weather text
run_test_cli: run the test_extending module as a CLI script and exit with failure count
